verdict.rationale: Fern's docs are authored in plain Markdown with OpenAPI-based API references stored in the user's own repo, and the project is open-source, giving a baseline of portability; but there's no explicit 'export all my data' feature, and the no-code Fern Editor (docs-2) implies some content may live outside a git repo, plus the community notes Fern's proprietary 'Fern Definition' format as an extra layer that isn't strictly required but exists (fern-comm-2). Missing for 10: an explicit bulk data/account export tool or API, and confirmation that Editor-authored content and analytics/config data can be exported in fully open formats without vendor tooling.
